about.descriptor: I build AI agent workflows for RF measurement systems — where messy real-world signal data meets LLM tooling.
about.bio_1: My work lives in the gap between a model that works on synthetic data and one that holds up on real measurements. I build tools that turn complex signal and test data into answers non-technical engineers can query directly.
about.bio_2: At National Instruments in Dresden, I built an end-to-end Accept-on-Retest analytics skill for NI Nigel — benchmarking Polars over pandas, adding Parquet caching, and writing custom 1σ–3σ band classification from scratch. Manufacturing engineers used it in production to run root-cause analysis on test data with no code.
about.bio_3: I'm pursuing an M.Sc. in Electromobility at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg, majoring in AI & Connectivity. Looking for roles in agentic AI, RF/wireless, or production ML — ideally where the work actually ships to real users.

ni_agent.name: Production AI Agent for RF Analytics
ni_agent.problem: Manufacturing engineers needed root-cause analysis across 30–40 test types without writing code
ni_agent.tech: Python · Polars · Parquet · Agent Skill · Plotly
ni_agent.description: Two projects at National Instruments, Dresden. First, a Euclidean-distance ranking algorithm for parametric test data, extended from single-test to test-agnostic operation across 30–40 VST test types. Second, an end-to-end Accept-on-Retest analytics skill for NI Nigel: Polars over pandas, Parquet caching, and custom 1σ–3σ band classification splitting outcomes into real failures, marginal failures, and noise. Engineers queried it in natural language and got root-cause summaries with Plotly visualisations — no code required.
ni_agent.what_went_wrong: Initially underestimated the overhead of repeatedly querying large-scale metadata. The system was stable but too slow for a conversational interface.
ni_agent.what_id_change: Move heavy data processing behind a robust caching layer from the start. In an AI agent, latency is as important as accuracy — if it takes 30 seconds to respond, people stop using it.

isac_drl.name: ISAC Beamforming via Deep RL
isac_drl.problem: Balancing communication throughput against sensing accuracy in mmWave ISAC has no closed-form solution
isac_drl.description: A DDPG agent learns to steer a MIMO beamformer in mmWave ISAC (Integrated Sensing and Communication), trading communication throughput against sensing accuracy end-to-end. Channel model: Saleh-Valenzuela clustered mmWave propagation; mobility from 3GPP Release 16 NR-V2X. The policy maps raw channel observations to beamforming weights and traces out the Pareto curve between sensing and communication, with convex baselines computed in CVXPY.

vlc.name: Vehicle-to-Vehicle Visible Light
vlc.problem: Low-latency V2V communication without RF spectrum allocation
vlc.tech: C · STM32 · OOK · Turbo Coding · MATLAB
vlc.description: An STM32-based vehicle-to-vehicle prototype using OOK optical modulation with Turbo coding for forward error correction to cut BER in noisy optical channels. LED driver circuitry simulated in Multisim for voltage stability; an MPPT algorithm modelled in MATLAB for a solar-powered transceiver. The hard part wasn't the link — it was ambient daylight swamping the photodetector, which forced adaptive thresholding.
vlc.what_went_wrong: Optimized for lab conditions first, then had to redesign for real-world lighting. Should have tested in daylight from day 1.
vlc.what_id_change: Start with the worst-case environment, not the best case. Physics doesn't care about your clean-room results.

iot.name: Secure IoT Data Transfer
iot.problem: Encrypted sensor telemetry on a resource-constrained microcontroller
iot.description: An ESP32-based IoT node for real-time encrypted sensor data over MQTT, with AES-128 encryption applied at the edge. SPIFFS handled secure key management and persistent device authentication so the node could re-establish a trusted session after a power cycle.

bengaluru.story: Home for 18 years. Grew up chasing monsoons, eating dosas at midnight, and learning that the best ideas come from chaos. The city that wired curiosity into me.

nurnberg.story: Arrived knowing no one. Left knowing what it means to build something from scratch in a foreign place. Christmas markets, long winters, and longer study sessions.

dresden.story: A quieter city with a complicated history and an unexpectedly vibrant tech scene. Learning to slow down without stopping.
